note: Authoritative register of the Oral examiner follow-up actions authorised for future production. This says WHAT is authorised. Each production batch writes its own batch_f*_manifest.json saying what was IMPLEMENTED. The two must never be collapsed.

authorisation.role: follow-up families and the 35 grouped insertion actions

decisions.role: per-family evidence: occurrences, decision basis, coverage

enrichment.role: follow-up / enrichment colocation on a shared parent card

provenance.derivation: Families dispositioned FOLLOWUP_ONLY are grouped by parent canonical question id; identifiers are re-derived and compared against the committed ones.

confidence_model.HIGH: decision_basis is hand adjudication against current answer bodies - a person reasoned about this parent card
confidence_model.MEDIUM: target chosen by coverage score, score still selects it, and best-answer coverage is at or above 0.60
confidence_model.LOW: target chosen by coverage score and either the score no longer selects it, or coverage is below 0.60
confidence_model.caution: A LAPTOP_CONFIRMED follow-up disposition confirms the DISPOSITION, not the target. All 39 families are LAPTOP_CONFIRMED; only 4 had their parent card chosen by hand.

reconciliation.grouping_rule: one action per parent canonical question id; families sharing a parent card are one insertion
reconciliation.id_assignment_rule: FUP-NNN in ascending lexicographic order of the parent canonical question id
